text:
Sam (partnerships): Quick sync — we need to finalize the partner integration launch playbook for the OTLP/collector flow + dashboard templates for Private & Dedicated customers. Target week: Apr 20. Who owns what?

Jess (Datadog): +1 — Datadog can deliver dashboard JSON + a collector config example. We can also provide a hosted demo org for the webinar.

Mike (eng-platform): Need to confirm collector config that works with our private deployment (air-gapped + KMS). Also will need helm values and a short runbook for on-prem install.

Nora (eng-sre): FYI we should expose these metrics/traces from the runtime: redwood.request.latency_p50/p95, redwood.kvcache.hits, redwood.batch.size_distribution. We need sensible sampling defaults (start 1% for prod traces) — otherwise dashboards will be noisy.

Carlo (product): Rollout plan: 1) early access for Dedicated customers 2) public listing in marketplace 3) joint announcement. We should gate by a quick quality eval (prompt suite) + internal beta. Who will sign off on GA?

Alexa (marketing): Need assets: partner logo (SVG), spokesperson quote, two screenshot-ready dashboards, and a 30s explainer GIF. Also, what embargo date should we use for PR?

Liz (legal): We'll need the partner PR/quote signoff and a simple partner addendum for the marketplace listing. Please allow 5 business days for review once copy is submitted.

deploy-bot: CI: integration-tests/collector-template passed — image build 1782.1.4 succeeded :white_check_mark:

Sam (partnerships): Good. I'll own launch coordination and the announcement timeline. Action items: collect dashboard JSON, collector helm values, runbook, legal copy, marketing assets, and a demo org. Can we map owners?

Jess (Datadog): Owner (DD): dashboard JSON + example OTLP pipeline. Dashboard link (preview): https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/redwood-integration-preview (internal). Example OTLP snippet:

```yaml
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Mike (eng-platform): Owner (Platform): helm values + on-prem install steps. Quick helm snippet for our collector overlay:

```yaml
replicaCount: 2
env:
  - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_DATADOG_API_KEY
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: dd-api-key
        key: api_key
volumes:
  - name: kms-config
    secret:
      secretName: redwood-kms-creds
```

Nora (eng-sre): Owner (SRE): sampling guidance + SLO dashboards. I'll draft a p95 latency SLO and a playbook for fallback to smaller model variant if latency > 500ms.

Carlo (product): Owner (Product): beta cohort selection and GA signoff checklist (quality eval pass + two paying customers on Dedicated).

Alexa (marketing): Owner (Marketing): press copy, webinar, assets. Proposed embargo: Apr 24 (publish Apr 27). That gives legal time.

Liz (legal): Confirmed: submit PR copy by Apr 21 to allow review. Also request for partner logos: provide vector and logo usage rules.

Sam (partnerships): Timeline summary:
- Apr 14: DD dashboard + collector examples (Jess)
- Apr 16: Helm/runbook draft (Mike)
- Apr 18: SRE playbook + SLOs (Nora)
- Apr 21: PR copy + logos (Alexa)
- Apr 22: Legal signoff target (Liz)
- Apr 24: embargo (marketing)
- Apr 27: public publish + webinar

Jess (Datadog): We'll aim to deliver dashboards by EOD Apr 13 so you have a day to review. Also happy to do a joint dry-run.

Mike (eng-platform): I'll add a sample values.yaml and a small k8s manifest to the docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/tree/main/integrations/collector

Nora (eng-sre): For the sampling defaults: recommend add a toggle in our Console to let customers opt-out of trace export per-workload. I'll put a short RFC in #eng-architecture.

Carlo (product): Can we include a small 'cost implications' note for customers (approx token / trace export cost)? That helps sales.

Alexa (marketing): Noted. I'll draft the one-pager with cost FAQ and send to Carlo for review by Apr 19.

Sam (partnerships): Final request: who will run the demo during the webinar? Volunteers? (prefer someone from Product + a Datadog engineer)

Jess (Datadog): I can join the demo with a DD engineer.

Carlo (product): I can present product part.

Sam (partnerships): Great — I'll schedule a dry-run Apr 25.

Jess (Datadog): Also attaching a tiny dashboard JSON (will post to team drive): `redwood_dd_dashboard_v1.json` — contains traces, latency histograms, and cache metrics.

Mike (eng-platform): I'll wire the example into the private demo cluster and share kubecontext + creds to the demo account (secure channel).

Liz (legal): Reminder: do not share partner quotes publicly until we have signed PR consent.

Sam (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll compile this thread into a checklist and drop a short Confluence-runbook. Action owners: DD (Jess), Platform (Mike), SRE (Nora), Product (Carlo), Marketing (Alexa), Legal (Liz).

Sam (partnerships): TL;DR — OTLP + dashboard launch for Private & Dedicated, embargo Apr 24, public Apr 27, dry-run Apr 25.
